protocol.comparison: Identical plan, config, encoder/GRU, log_std, critic, optimizer, world/sampling state and exploration RNG; neutral arm zeros only action-head weight/bias before fresh training. Both use actor-only initialization API.
protocol.training_distribution: Four isolated tasks. Near-formation/visible-chain curriculum retained with 15mm position jitter. Probability decays from 1 to .9999997 over the budget; realized fraction is logged.
protocol.diagnostic_evaluation: three formations at 15mm and 50mm jitter; moving follow from chain; ordinary random-start tasks and all directed switches reported separately
protocol.gates: unchanged; no near-goal results counted as random-start acceptance
protocol.promotion: No automatic default change; full goal and hardware gates unchanged
protocol.startup_provenance_note: Configuration and both initialization checkpoints were written before launch. A tensor-valued snapshot assertion failed in the setup script before source-pin/protocol serialization. Both already-live trainers imported the unchanged worktree source and saved matching source snapshots. The recursive assertion was corrected and source hashes verified; only the observer pin/protocol were then finalized. No trainer restart. No loss or evaluation outcomes were inspected before protocol finalization.

energy_learning_health.scope: Command-energy-only learning-health experiment. All formation/progress/contact/time costs and entropy weight are zero. Does not establish formation, following, safety or switching success.

task_gradient_probe.scope: Local sampled gradient alignment, not proof of a unique training failure cause or a proposed gradient surgery fix.

isolated_circle_motion.scope: 15 near-start formation recordings after 2s warmup; actual rim speeds, provisional separation .082m; holding position is not stopping

task_selection.legacy_proof: 3072 joint steps, 8 subsequent resets, one optimizer update, 2401 exact leaves

protocol.initialization: unchanged fresh actor/critic/optimizer; independent actor action model; no actor-only initialization override
protocol.hypothesis: Check each task before combining; energy-only PPO reduced fixed-input mean-square commands by 93.6%, while retained-near-start multitask pilots failed. Local gradient probe found 7/21 negative represented task pairs, with larger following advantage variance. This does not prove a unique cause.
protocol.evaluation: each stage receives unchanged full 85-episode random-start/switch suite, five chain-follow episodes, and 30 near-formation diagnostics; untrained tasks remain explicit
protocol.limits: Single training seed and easy starts do not establish full-goal behavior. Initial task-dependent pose/RNG distributions differ from the mixed-task pilot; not a causal paired-quality estimate. No promotion or automatic budget extension.

actor_initialization.semantics: actor only; fresh critic/optimizer/world/RNG; no exact-resume claim

protocol.motivation: Circle-only stage held all 15 near-goal formation diagnostics but corrected only 1/15 larger-jitter cases, equal to zero-command baseline. Increase training position jitter from 15mm to 50mm to require physical correction.
protocol.evaluation: unchanged full 85-episode random/switch suite, five chain-follow episodes and 30 near-formation diagnostics; distinguish initially-in-goal from actual acquisition
protocol.heldout_seeds: reserved and unused in this study
protocol.numeric_gates: unchanged; no easy-start result replaces full-goal acceptance
protocol.promotion: no automatic default change or budget extension
